import sys,pathlib,shutil,json,hashlib,subprocess
root=pathlib.Path('/home/mii/code/konOSuba/suba');sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'tools'))
from check_kernel_entry import observe,image,require,FIRMWARE
compiler=(root/'../biomiya/build/layout-p4-r1/e3.elf').resolve()
out=root/'build/k2-acceptance-negatives-r1';out.mkdir()
base=root/'build/k2-acceptance-memory-r1/valid'
report={'reviewer':'/root/k2_acceptance','compiler_sha256':hashlib.sha256(compiler.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'cases':[],'passed':False}
try:
 for name,old,new,reason in [('last-word-not-cleared','while word < PAGE_BYTES / 8_usize {','while word < PAGE_BYTES / 8_usize - 1_usize {',24),('generation-reused','SLOTS[index].generation = SLOTS[index].generation + 1_u32;','SLOTS[index].generation = 1_u32;',26)]:
  work=out/name;shutil.copytree(base,work)
  memory=work/'kernel/memory.vt';src=memory.read_text();require(src.count(old)==1,'unique mutation anchor');memory.write_text(src.replace(old,new))
  item={'name':name,'mutation':{'old':old,'new':new},'expected_panic':reason,'commands':[]};report['cases'].append(item)
  for p in [work/'build/kernel.elf',work/'build/boot.elf']:p.unlink()
  def build(manifest):
   command=['qemu-riscv64','-s','1048576',str(compiler),'build',manifest]
   result=subprocess.run(command,cwd=work,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=120)
   item['commands'].append({'command':command,'cwd':str(work),'returncode':result.returncode,'stdout':result.stdout,'stderr':result.stderr});require(result.returncode==0,'compile rejected')
  build('kernel/kernel.build');item['kernel']=image(work/'build/kernel.elf',0x80400000,0x4000000)
  (work/'config.vt').write_text('module test::config;\npub const MAGIC: usize = 0x314f464e49425553;\n'+f'pub const KERNEL_END: usize = {item["kernel"]["end"]};\npub const KERNEL_ENTRY: usize = {item["kernel"]["entry"]};\n')
  build('boot.build')
  command=['qemu-system-riscv64','-machine','virt','-accel','tcg','-m','512M','-smp','1','-nographic','-bios',str(FIRMWARE),'-kernel',str(work/'build/boot.elf'),'-device',f'loader,file={work}/build/kernel.elf','-device','ramfb','-no-reboot']
  item['execution']=observe(command,f'suba kernel panic reason={reason}\n',('memory: verified','handoff accepted','!'))
  events=[l for l in item['execution']['log'].splitlines() if l.startswith(('suba ','!'))]
  item['events']=events;item['passed']=item['execution']['passed'] and events==['suba K0 boot: entering kernel',f'suba kernel panic reason={reason}']
  require(item['passed'],f'{name} unexpected outcome');print(name,events,flush=True)
 report['passed']=True
finally:
 (out/'verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')

notes: First reviewer hash check assumed a flat dependency schema and failed before completing; corrected checker handles M nested dependency records. No acceptance relied on failed attempt.
No compiler production changes or complete bootstrap rerun.
QEMU stop observation is a finite 500 ms interval, not an infinite halt proof.
